decisions.reason: The cleaning soap complements the firm's core wood flooring offer and draws on its surface-treatment know-how, so the firm can read early results and refine it at low cost.
The maintenance oil line sits directly on the firm's own surface-treatment R&D and supports aftersales relationships with installers and homeowners.
Care products for oiled floors match the firm's oiled-floor finishes, so its existing knowledge makes it easy to assimilate customer feedback and improve the line.
A moisture-protection underlay is a natural system accessory that the firm's technical installation guidance can support and refine.
Foam underlay is further from the firm's wood-processing core, but it is a standard system component that is likely sourced from partners and is cheap to keep within the accessory range.
The oak parquet line is at the heart of the firm's wood-processing expertise and production base, giving it the strongest absorptive capacity for further development.
